b:
Holding the rope
he looked up
at the ceiling beam.

It seemed to him
that it was calling,
"Come"

From his eyes
tears streamed

He was not crying

Even if he looked for a reason to cry
he could not find one

The walls of loneliness
are wider
than the walls of the room..

Through the closed window
he longs
for a thin streak of light

That darkness
gave him only disappointment

Will dawn come?
He did not believe it

This too was one of those nights
when sleep was lost.

He had even forgotten how to sleep

In a life that had known only defeat
he resolved
to lose one final time

From somewhere, a call,
to hear his voice,
to hear his troubles

That night he lived
Dawn came
From that day on he lives,
a winner
